title: Legal Secretary Employment Law
company: Harwood Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
I'm currently recruiting for a friendly, organised and proactive Secretary to join a busy Employment team in Bristol. If you enjoy being part of a busy team, are confident with document production and like being someone your colleagues can rely on, we'd love to hear from you.

You'll help keep things organised, support our lawyers and play an important role in making sure our clients receive a great service.

You'll provide day-to-day secretarial and administrative support to our Employment lawyers, helping them manage their workload and keep things running smoothly.

No two days will be exactly the same. You'll be involved in everything from preparing documents and managing diaries to dealing with calls, emails, meetings and general administration. You'll also have plenty of opportunity to build relationships with colleagues and clients and become a valued part of the team.

Day to day, you'll:
- Produce accurate, professional documents and correspondence, including copy typing and occasional audio transcription.
- Manage diaries, emails, calls and meeting arrangements for the lawyers you support.
- Maintain files and records, keeping everything organised and up to date.
- Support billing and other financial administration where required.
- Deal with incoming and outgoing correspondence, including arranging signing and despatch.
- Work closely with colleagues across the Employment team and wider firm, helping out where needed.

We're looking for someone with previous secretarial experience, ideally within a legal or professional services environment, although this isn't essential.

You'll be organised, reliable and confident producing accurate work, with good typing and document production skills. Just as importantly, you'll be approachable, helpful and enjoy working as part of a team.

We're looking for someone who has:
- Good typing and document production skills, including occasional audio typing.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage your own workload.
- Strong attention to detail and pride in the quality of your work.
- A flexible and positive approach, with a willingness to support colleagues.
- Confidence using Microsoft Word and other standard office technology.

For more details of the experience we're looking for, please click apply today!

title: Personal Injury Paralegal
description:
Personal Injury Paralegal

Bristol

Salary up to 30,000 DOE

Yolk Recruitment is working with a national law firm looking to recruit a Personal Injury Paralegal to join its Serious & Catastrophic Injury team in Bristol.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with claimant Personal Injury experience who wants to develop their exposure to more complex, high-value injury work.

Rather than being expected to independently manage a significant caseload, you will work closely with senior members of the team, assisting with serious and catastrophic injury claims. The position would particularly suit a Paralegal, Legal Assistant or PI Case Handler looking to build their technical knowledge while learning directly from experienced serious injury specialists.

The role offers hybrid working, with two days per week in the Bristol office and three days working from home.

This is what you will be doing

As a Personal Injury Paralegal, your duties and responsibilities will include:
- Assisting senior case handlers with serious and catastrophic personal injury claims.
- Helping with the day-to-day progression and organisation of complex PI files.
- Collating medical records, evidence relating to liability and evidence supporting uninsured losses.
- Organising client and expert meetings and conferences with Counsel.
- Liaising with clients, insurers, expert witnesses, solicitors and other parties.
- Maintaining accurate case records and ensuring matters are progressed in line with relevant service standards.
- Participating in regular case and risk assessment meetings.

The experience you will bring to the team

You will bring the following experience to the Personal Injury team:
- Previous experience within claimant Personal Injury, either handling claims or assisting with a PI caseload.
- Experience using a legal case management system.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- A good approach to client care.
- An interest in developing your knowledge of serious and catastrophic injury work.

Previous litigation experience and experience using bundling software would be advantageous but aren't essential.

This is what you will get in return
- Salary up to 30,000 depending on experience.
- Hybrid working with only two days per week required in the Bristol office.
- Exposure to serious and catastrophic Personal Injury work.
- The opportunity to work closely with experienced senior case handlers.
- Training, development and routes towards further legal qualification.
- Annual leave and employee welfare benefits.
- Health cash plan and gym/lifestyle benefits.
- Employee recognition and referral schemes.
- A genuine opportunity to broaden your technical Personal Injury experience.

Are you up to the challenge?

If you're a Personal Injury Paralegal ready to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or get in touch to find out more. All enquiries will be handled in the strictest confidence by Yolk Recruitment. title: Family Legal Assistant
description:
Family Legal Assistant

Bath

Salary up to 32,000

An established regional law firm is looking for a Legal Assistant to support its Family Law department in Bath. This is a hands-on role working closely with family lawyers and clients, providing both legal and administrative support while helping the team deliver an excellent service to people who may be dealing with difficult and sensitive circumstances. No specific professional qualification is required, but previous legal work experience is essential.

This is what you will be doing

Your responsibilities and duties in the Family team will include:-
- Supporting solicitors within the Family Law team
- Assisting with client matters where appropriate
- Undertaking legal research
- Drafting legal documents
- Preparing files for billing
- Dealing with incoming calls, correspondence, emails and messages
- Liaising with clients and other parties
- Providing an empathetic and professional service to clients
- Working in accordance with Lexcel and relevant Law Society requirements
- Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the department

The experience you will bring to the team

You will bring the following experience to the Family team:-
- Experience drafting legal documents
